name: Zarza la Mayor (Spain)
description: Green field with a red diagonal band at the upper hoist and a blue triangle at the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Zarza la Mayor (fleurs-de-lis on blue and a tree on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Zarza la Mayor; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Zarza la Mayor arms — fleurs-de-lis and tree
